mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log ( actor_user_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, ip_hash, before_json, after_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{actionType}, #{targetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{ipHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beforeJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{afterJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO operation_log (log_level, event_code, message, context_json, created_at) VALUES (#{logLevel}, #{eventCode}, #{message}, #{contextJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())
